messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "start with 0.25 mg subcutaneous injection once weekly for 4 weeks"
set: ["start with 0.25 mg subcutaneous injection once weekly for 4 weeks", "increase dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.25 mg", "initiate Wegovy injection with a dose of 0.25 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly", "start with 3 mg once daily for 30 days", "once weekly", "increase dosage to 1 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.5 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "increase dosage to 2 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 1 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "increase to 5 mg subcutaneously once a week after 4 weeks", "4 to 6 weeks for full effects", "start with 25 mg a day", "reduce dose to 1.7 mg once weekly", "4 weeks after starting", "87% after 4 weeks", "dose not increased more than once every 4 weeks", "patients who tolerate the 2.4 mg dosage for at least 4 weeks", "symptoms may not improve for up to 4 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
